title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.41: Diagnostics only - Fate Knocking now logs a per-hit damage breakdown on every play, to track down a remaining case where its finisher preview reads one higher than the hit lands for. No gameplay changes.
